title: Marble Skill Taxonomy: 1,590 school micro-topics connected by 3,221 prerequisite edges as a graph
description:
Marble Skill Taxonomy maps what a child learns across primary school as a connected graph, not the usual flat list of standards. This breaks it into 1,590 teachable micro-topics, each with an age range and evidence for mastery, then wires 3,221 prerequisite edges between them, so you can trace everything a kid must grasp before, say, apparent brightness of stars. 

https://github.com/withmarbleapp/os-taxonomy
